lead.zh-Hans: 他举着胳膊，我先跟着看了墙。
lead.en: I followed his arm to the wrong destination.

text.zh-Hans: 中央邮局的历史地图前，一位旅人举着胳膊，眼睛却总往入口瞟。我顺着他的手看了半天，没找到他指的是哪一处，便也抬起头认真找。后来他朝我摇摇手，我才知道那条胳膊是在招呼别人。他看我一直仰着头，忍不住笑了。我把踮起的脚跟放下，站到他身旁，入口终于从我的帽檐底下露了出来。
text.en: A traveler held an arm up before the Central Post Office’s historic maps, but kept glancing at the entrance. I followed his hand along the wall, trying to find the place he meant. When he waved at me, I realized the raised arm was meant to attract someone, not indicate a map. He laughed at my upward gaze. I lowered my heels and stood beside him. The entrance finally came into view beneath my brim.

text.zh-Hans: 问问他在等谁
text.en: Ask whom he is waiting for

text.zh-Hans: 看看眼神朝着哪边
text.en: Notice where he keeps looking

lead.zh-Hans: 他的箱子走得快，人却没有超过我。
lead.en: His suitcase overtook me without him.

text.zh-Hans: 阮惠步行街上，旅伴拉着的小箱子总比他先走一点。我好奇地低头看，他便把箱子停在身旁，让我试着拉一小段。我握住把手，小箱子顺顺地跟过来，自己的邮包却在另一边一下一下碰腿。我没有再加快，把箱子送回他手里。他重新迈步，我跟在旁边，两个包终于不再争着抢我同一条腿。
text.en: My companion’s small suitcase kept traveling a little ahead of him on Nguyễn Huệ. Seeing my curiosity, he let me pull it for a short stretch. The wheels followed easily, but my mailbag began bumping the other leg. I slowed and returned the handle. When we resumed side by side, the two bags were no longer competing for possession of my knees.

text.zh-Hans: 谢谢他借我拉一小段
text.en: Thank him for letting me try the case

text.zh-Hans: 看看箱子与脚步的距离
text.en: Watch the space between wheels and feet

lead.zh-Hans: 午饭先转了个方向，我的手才腾得开。
lead.en: Turning lunch made room for my hands.

text.zh-Hans: 夹馅面包里的黄瓜从一头探出来，我捧着转了半圈，才找到不让馅料滑出去的吃法。旅伴吃碎米饭，见我终于咬稳第一口，便把自己的小碟挪近，分给我尝一点米饭。我先把面包放下才接勺子，等尝完再重新拿起来。两样午饭各自回到原位，黄瓜那一头已经短了，露在外面的只剩一点绿色。
text.en: Cucumber protruded from one end of my bánh mì. Turning the sandwich helped me take a bite without losing its filling. My companion, eating cơm tấm, offered a little rice from his side plate. I put the bread down before taking the spoon, tasted it, then returned to the sandwich. Both lunches regained their places. The cucumber’s ambitious end had been reduced to a small green edge.

text.zh-Hans: 告诉旅伴两样都尝好了
text.en: Tell my companion I have tried both lunches

text.zh-Hans: 看看面包哪一端更稳
text.en: Check which end of the bread is secure

lead.zh-Hans: 米粒很小，勺子不必堆得像山。
lead.en: Small grains did not require a mountain on the spoon.

text.zh-Hans: 吃过夹馅面包，我想换一盘碎米饭。第一勺被我堆得很高，刚拿起就有几粒落回盘里。我索性减掉一半，添上一点鱼露，慢慢吃好。邻座还以为我在等什么，抬头看了我两回，我便举起空勺给他看，说这趟已经送到了。他点点头继续吃，自己的勺子比我那把大些，我们倒差不多同时放了下来。
text.en: Having tried bánh mì, I chose cơm tấm for another meal. I heaped the first spoonful so high that a few grains returned to the plate. Halving it and adding a little fish sauce worked better. My neighbor kept glancing up, apparently wondering what I was waiting for. I showed him the empty spoon and reported a completed delivery. His spoon was larger, but we set them down at almost the same moment.

text.zh-Hans: 报告这一勺已经送到
text.en: Report a safely delivered spoonful

text.zh-Hans: 看看勺里的分量
text.en: Check the size of each spoonful

lead.zh-Hans: 我退到镜头后面，照片里反而站得下了。
lead.en: Stepping behind the camera made room in the picture.

text.zh-Hans: 步行街上，一家人挤在一起等拍照，拿相机的旅人往旁边挪了几次，还是摇头。我停在远处，问能不能替他们拍一张，让他也进去。他高兴地教我按哪里，自己跑回人群，又认真把肩膀缩窄。我两手拿稳，等他们站好才拍。相机还回去时，小朋友先凑来看，刚才缩起来的肩膀在照片里终于松开了。
text.en: A family squeezed together for a picture on the walking street. The traveler holding the camera kept shifting and shaking his head. I offered to take it so he could join them. After showing me the button, he hurried into the group and carefully narrowed his shoulders. I held the camera with both hands and waited until everyone settled. When I handed it back, a child leaned in first. In the picture, those tight shoulders had finally relaxed.

text.zh-Hans: 请大家站好再拍
text.en: Ask everyone to settle before the photo

text.zh-Hans: 看看镜头里是否都站下了
text.en: Check that everyone fits in the frame

lead.zh-Hans: 小玩具先出发，我替它走完桌底这一段。
lead.en: The toy began its journey beneath the table.

text.zh-Hans: 碎米饭吃好，旁边的孩子把一只布玩具掉到桌下，弯腰却只够得到它的一只脚。我先问能不能帮他捡，再把自己的椅子往后挪，稳稳蹲下递回去。他抱好玩具，郑重替它向我道谢。我说这趟只走到桌底，不必带那么多行李。先前尝过的夹馅面包已经吃完，桌上空出的位置正好让那只玩具坐得直直的。
text.en: After my cơm tấm, a child dropped a cloth toy beneath the neighboring table and could reach only one foot. I asked before moving my chair back, crouching and returning it. Hugging the toy, he solemnly thanked me on its behalf. I explained that a journey only as far as the table needed very little luggage. My earlier bánh mì was finished too, leaving a clear place where the toy could sit perfectly upright.

text.zh-Hans: 向玩具的主人说声不客气
text.en: Tell the toy’s owner he is welcome

text.zh-Hans: 看看桌下有没有别的东西
text.en: Check beneath the table

lead.zh-Hans: 你说“{reply}”，我先问了举手的旅人。
lead.en: You wrote, “{reply}.” I asked the traveler with the raised arm.

text.zh-Hans: 我问举着胳膊的旅人在等谁。他说同伴带着一只小箱子，怕对方看不见，才一直举着手。我指指旁边空一点的位置，我们一起移开几步，让入口那边看得更清楚。小箱子终于出现，同伴先挥手，随后才拉着箱子走近。旅人放下胳膊时揉了揉肩，我也把自己的包换到另一边，大厅里三个人各自舒展了一下。
text.en: I asked whom the traveler was waiting for. His companion had a small suitcase, and he had kept his arm raised so they would spot him. We moved a few steps into a clearer position. At last the little case appeared. Its owner waved before approaching. The traveler lowered his arm and rubbed his shoulder. I shifted my own bag to the other side, and all three of us took a moment to stretch in the foyer.

text.zh-Hans: 向拉箱子的同伴问好
text.en: Greet the companion with the case

text.zh-Hans: 看看放下胳膊的肩膀
text.en: Notice the shoulder finally at rest

lead.zh-Hans: 影子挨在一起，脚步还各有自己的长短。
lead.en: Our shadows met before our strides agreed.

text.zh-Hans: 回到胡志明市，阮惠步行街宽宽的路面让我认出了方向。一个孩子想把自己的影子接到大人的影子上，总往旁边挪，大人便停下来等。我走近时，邮包的影子也凑了进去，孩子笑着跳开，又站回来给它留位置。我把包提稳，没有跟着追。等他们一起往前走，三道影子在地上短短接上，随后各自拉开了一点。
text.en: Returning to Ho Chi Minh City, I recognized Nguyễn Huệ’s broad walking space. A child kept sidling over to join his shadow to an adult’s, who stopped to wait. My mailbag’s shadow entered their arrangement as I passed. The child hopped aside, laughed and returned with room for it. I held the bag steady rather than chasing him. As they moved on, our three shadows briefly joined, then opened out again.

text.zh-Hans: 问孩子要留多宽的位置
text.en: Ask how much space the child wants

text.zh-Hans: 看看三道影子如何分开
text.en: Watch the shadows separate
